page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.6xlarge is an x86_64 virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 24 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, which positions it within the memory-optimized category.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory density relative to compute resources makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require large memory footprints but do not demand high-performance local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration. It is suited for hosting in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications.
